log.msg: Qwen (qwen2.5-coder:7b) is designing the kitchen - under a minute
Applying the MagickHome rule book: module sizes for this kitchen size and shape
Applying design rules: window, door, corner and chimney clearances
Building the 3D scene: cabinets, appliances, countertops, panels

raw.room_reading: The room is a square with four equal walls, each 4100 mm long. There are windows on two walls, which means there are no free runs on those walls. One wall is designated for the hob, and another for the sink. The kitchen is small, with a 172
raw.design_plan: Given the small size of the kitchen, a U-shape layout with a hob on Wall 1 and a sink on Wall 2 is suitable. The base cabinets will be a mix of shutters and drawers, with tall storage units above the柜
raw.layout_why: A U-shape layout maximizes space utilization in a small kitchen, placing the hob near the windows for ventilation and easy access to the sink.
raw.sink_why: The sink is placed on Wall 2, which is one of the longer walls, providing enough space for a double-shutter unit.
raw.hob_why: The hob is placed on Wall 1, which is also one of the longer walls, providing enough space for a double-drawer unit.
raw.lpg_why: LPG is assumed as the gas type, so the cylinder unit is included.
raw.tall_why: Tall storage units will be placed on Wall 3, which is the only free run wall.
raw.purifier_why: Water purifier is not stated, so it will be excluded.
raw.display_why: Glass display is not stated, so it will be excluded.
raw.open_why: Open shelf unit is not stated, so it will be excluded.
raw.storage_why: Base cabinets will be a mix of shutters and drawers to maximize storage space.
raw.features_why: Corner units and a corner loft will be included for additional storage and aesthetics.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: Standard wall cabinets with hinged shutters will be used on Wall 2.
raw.wall_style_why: Hinged shutters are chosen for the base run on Wall 2 for better aesthetics and space utilization.
raw.finish_why: The base run will have a mix of finishes to match the customer's preference. Wall run will have a high-gloss finish.
raw.loft_why: Lofts will be included above the wall cabinets on Wall 3 to maximize storage space.

customer_needs: - Door style Slab (Plain); layout preference U; wants tall storage.
- Water purifier: water purifier not stated.
- Gas: not stated - LPG is assumed, so the cylinder unit is included (rule R11).
- Built-in appliances: built-in appliances not stated.
- Glass display: glass display not stated.
- Cooking: cooking style not stated; household size not stated.
- Base cabinets: base cabinet style not stated - you choose drawers, mixed or shutters.
- Wall cabinets: door type not stated - you choose hinged shutters or lift-up; open shelf unit not stated.
- Finishes: base run not stated - you choose; wall run not stated - you choose (the codes allowed are the ones the budget tier permits).

explanation.why: The hob is placed on Wall 1, which is also one of the longer walls, providing enough space for a double-drawer unit.
rules: R69: In a Large U-Shape kitchen (121–180 sqft), set the Base Hob Unit width to 900 mm. (the designer chose 900 mm Hob Double Drawer)

explanation.why: Hinged shutters are chosen for the base run on Wall 2 for better aesthetics and space utilization.

explanation.why: Open shelf unit is not stated, so it will be excluded.

details: Ceiling (lowest wall) 2500 mm; a loft needs 2658 mm

explanation.built: Wall cabinets 600 mm, tall units 1940 mm
explanation.why: No lofts (the ceiling, 2500 mm, is below the 2658 mm a loft needs - R47): standard 600 mm wall and 1940 mm tall units.
details: Wall cabinets hang from 1440 mm up to 2040 mm; tall units stand on the 100 mm plinth and end at the same line
Height pairs in the catalogue: 600 / 1940, 700 / 2040, 900 / 2240 mm (wall / tall)

explanation.built: Base + tall: Cadet Blue (PU matte, Magickhome); Wall + loft: Earl Grey (Acrylic high gloss, Rehau)
explanation.why: The base run will have a mix of finishes to match the customer's preference. Wall run will have a high-gloss finish.
details: Base run (base + tall units): Cadet Blue (PU matte, Magickhome) - chosen by the designer
Wall run (wall units + lofts): Earl Grey (Acrylic high gloss, Rehau) - chosen by the designer
Tall units take the base-run finish and lofts take the wall-run finish (finish continuity).
Fillers, slabs, end panels and cover panels take the finish of the run they close (workbook: Filler Panel / Cover End Panel finish must match the cabinets).
rules: No budget stated: any finish allowed

explanation.why: Corners take only corner cabinets, facing the room; a corner stays open when a door or window leaves no room for one.
